title: yadakchi.listings.observed.v1
description:
One observed seller listing, exactly as fetched. crawler interprets nothing.

Producers: crawler. Consumers: enricher.
Kafka message key: {source_key}:{external_key} — it must be set; compaction and partition ordering depend on it.
Cleanup: delete, retention 90 days.

This file validates a whole Kafka message body: the shared envelope from docs/specs/02-EVENT-CONTRACTS.md plus this topic's payload. Unknown fields are ignored, never rejected, at both levels — that is what lets a producer add an optional field without breaking a consumer.

event_id.description: UUIDv4, unique per emission. Two emissions of the same fact carry different event_ids; consumers deduplicate on the payload's natural identity, not on this.

event_type.description: The topic name without the 'yadakchi.' prefix and without the version suffix.

version.description: Envelope and payload version. A removed field, a renamed field or a changed type is a breaking change: publish to .v2 and run both until consumers migrate.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened, ISO-8601 UTC with Z. Consumers tolerate out-of-order delivery across partitions by comparing this, never by assuming global ordering.

producer.description: The service that emitted this message. Constrained to the producers declared for this topic in platform/kafka/topics.yml.

trace_id.description: Propagated across the whole chain for debugging. Minted by crawler on yadakchi.listings.observed.v1 and carried through every derived event; a service starting a chain of its own (a human admin edit, a scheduled recomputation) mints a fresh one. Every service logs it.

payload.description: The full page lives in MinIO, not in Kafka. The per-listing fragment is inline because enricher needs it and re-fetching would be expensive. This topic is not compacted, so payload is never null; there is no tombstone on a delete-retention topic.

source_key.description: Stable slug of the source this listing was fetched from, minted by crawler.

external_key.description: The seller's own id or url path. Stable within the source; it is half of the offer_uid input.

url.description: Canonical URL of the listing on the seller's site.

raw_title.description: The listing title exactly as published. Never normalized here.

raw_price_text.description: Price text untouched, e.g. "۲٬۴۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان". null when the page shows no price.

raw_stock_text.description: Stock text untouched, e.g. "موجود در انبار". null when the page states nothing.

image_url.description: Listing image URL, or null when the listing has no image.

raw_fragment.description: HTML or JSON of this listing only, capped at 64 KB. The maxLength below is a character ceiling; the 64 KB cap is on encoded bytes and is enforced by the producer.

archive_uri.description: MinIO path to the full page snapshot in the raw-archive bucket, named by the page's own hash: {source_key}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{page_hash}.gz. That page_hash is crawler's alone and is deliberately NOT on the wire.

fragment_hash.description: sha256 of raw_fragment, lowercase hex. This is the hash that means 'this listing changed'. It is NOT the hash of the archived page: a page whose navigation or advert markup changed has a new page_hash and an unchanged fragment_hash, and conflating the two makes every unchanged listing look changed.

observed_at.description: When the listing was fetched. Replays reuse the original value.
